items.caption: Simulates a light effect on the background image for light on/off. When the light status is off, the filter uses maximum strength. When the light is on, the effect is disabled. If you specify a dim variable, the dim value controls the effect intensity. You can use a bool variable for light status and an integer or float variable for the dim value.
